the molecular mechanisms underlying the host range adaptation of a coronavirus in cultured cells.
the molecular mechanism underlying the adaptation of a coronavirus to different cell types and provides a better understanding of how the coronavirus host range is determined.

the cell–cell membrane fusion activity is a determinant of the cell specificity of IBV and other coronaviruses.
